## Checklist

- [ ] `./tools/check.sh` passes
- [ ] Tested on a real Parrot OS machine: what was run and what came out is in the description
- [ ] Nothing personal or from a company: usernames, emails, hostnames, IPs, keys, tokens
- [ ] A change people notice has its line in `CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.es.md`
- [ ] A document changed in one language is changed in the other
